n: TCI AI Literacy lesson and resource collection
t: A TCI page of AI literacy lessons, a course, and videos for checking AI content.
steps: Find the TCI AI literacy resource page.
Open the lesson called AI Literacy.
Check which resources need a TCI license.
Ask your TCI contact about the course login.
Ask IT to review TCI's data terms.
Preview the summit videos before class.
Decide whether students will use any AI feature.
